body.prompt: Cinematic western trailer score, 60 seconds, instrumental. Starts sparse and tense: a lone detuned saloon piano and low cello drone. Builds slowly with a soft heartbeat drum and a tremolo baritone guitar. At 34 seconds it stops dead for silence. At 50 seconds a big low brass and timpani hit for the title, then a lonely harmonica phrase that fades out. Gritty, dusty spaghetti-western feel, no vocals.
